name: PT Ateliers Mecaniques D'Indonesie Tbk
summary: PT Ateliers Mecaniques D'Indonesie Tbk designs, manufactures, and erects boilers in Indonesia, Cameroon, the Republic of Cote D'Ivoire, Papua New Guinea, Nigeria, Liberia, Malaysia, and Sao Tome and Principe. It offers solid fuel membrane wall boilers, solid fuel brick wall boilers, combi boilers, and firetube boilers. The company also provides horizontal and vertical sterilizers; sterilizer doors; and deaerators for use in the removal of air and other dissolved gases primarily oxygen from the feed water to boiler drum. In addition, it offers air-preheater, economizer, superheater, and dust collectors; palm oil mill equipment; and designs and fabricates pressure vessel tanks, piping systems, and boilers for the palm oil industry. Further, the company is involved in the trade and assembly of a range of machinery; plant/factory construction activities; and provision of repair, modification, technical, contract, maintenance, and replacement of parts services, as well as agency and marketing activities. It serves palm oil processing factories, rubber processing factories, wood processing factories, steam power plants, sugar factories; and chemical, textile, hotel, laundry, and other factories. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Deli Serdang, Indonesia. PT Ateliers Mecaniques D'Indonesie Tbk is a subsidiary of Sphere Corporation SDN BHD.
